purpose: Train a T One Walmart Marketplace expert for evidence-backed US, CA and MX operations without claiming unconnected tools or bypassing approval gates.

distillation_evidence_layers.official_current: Current first-party Walmart page or API reference captured with site, mode, date and fingerprint.
distillation_evidence_layers.verified_software_observation: Observed output from an actually opened T One or authorized software surface; a failed launch remains a failed observation.
distillation_evidence_layers.multi_source_practice: A practice supported by at least three independent non-official sources and not conflicting with official rules.
distillation_evidence_layers.single_case: One dated seller, forum, blog or video case; keep as a hypothesis and never promote to a platform rule.
distillation_evidence_layers.historical_trace: A dated prior operation or repository state retained for traceability but not current authority.
distillation_evidence_layers.unknown: Evidence is missing, blocked, stale or insufficient for the requested route and effect.

evidence_requirements.no_new_external_evidence_policy: Do not add learned rules; report that no new evidence was obtained and why.

shared_runtime.selection_policy: Use rules and parsers first, then the smallest healthy configured model that satisfies modality, cost, latency, budget and data-boundary requirements.

category_capability.rule: Load the current official Walmart item taxonomy/specification and category compliance rules for the target site and product type. Category modules are replaceable and must not invent fields when the schema is unavailable.

tenant_project_product.missing_fact_policy: Return unknown and request only the minimum missing owner fact; never substitute another tenant, project, product or store sample.

task_evidence.rule: Listings, campaigns, orders, media, customer events, failures and results belong only to the producing task and may be promoted only as anonymized methods after review.

marketplace_seller.rule: The seller operates on a specific Walmart Marketplace country site.

seller_origin.rule: Domestic versus international identifies business origin and required onboarding evidence; it is not a commerce mode and never removes country-site routing.

wfs.rule: Walmart Fulfillment Services is fulfillment, storage, returns and support capability subject to country enrollment and item eligibility; it is not a store type.

pro_seller.rule: Pro Seller is a performance status with country-specific, time-sensitive criteria; it is not a seller plan, store type or fulfillment mode.

marketplace_api.rule: Marketplace APIs cover authorized seller objects such as items, inventory, orders, returns, pricing, notifications and reports according to per-endpoint market availability.

walmart_connect.rule: Walmart Connect advertiser and API access are separate from Marketplace seller authorization.

walmart_marketplace_sem.rule: Marketplace SEM is a US-only paid Google Shopping acquisition surface managed through Walmart Marketplace and its OAuth scopes; it is separate from Walmart Connect and from the seller's own Google Ads account.

connect_reporting_only.rule: Reporting Only can read advertising data but cannot create, edit or optimize campaigns.

connect_full_service.rule: Full-Service may manage campaigns only for explicitly granted advertiser accounts and still requires T One owner approval for writes and spend.

tool_states.surface: Official Developer Portal, Marketplace Learn and Walmart Connect public pages
tool_states.data_boundary: Public official material only; obey site terms, rate limits and copyright.
tool_states.current_fact: Used for this dated training pass; not a persistent T One connector.

tool_states.surface: Items, inventory, price, orders, returns, notifications and reports
tool_states.data_boundary: One seller/store/country authorization per execution route; store only credential_ref.
tool_states.current_fact: Local api_sources entry is disabled and still declares legacy signed auth; current official authorization is OAuth 2.0.

tool_states.surface: US Payment Statement, Recon JSON and available reconciliation dates
tool_states.data_boundary: Matching US seller/store authorization and report scope only; preserve raw financial payloads and never reuse settlement identity across sites or stores.
tool_states.current_fact: The US API Reference confirms GET /v3/report/payment/statement and a detailed response example. The dated 2026-07-06 Global mapping identifies no active Global equivalent for the inspected US payment-report endpoints. No OAuth token, sandbox/live payload, seller report, payout, bank record or ERP mapping was evidenced; CA/MX contracts remain unknown.

tool_states.data_boundary: One verified browser identity per real store; no CAPTCHA or MFA bypass.
tool_states.current_fact: No Walmart Seller Center session or store binding was evidenced in the reviewed handoff/configs.

tool_states.surface: Seller Center AI-Powered Listing Tool, item-editing content suggestions and Smart Assistant
tool_states.data_boundary: US-facing public capability evidence only; a matching store identity is required for private inputs, outputs or actions, and CA/MX availability is unknown.
tool_states.current_fact: US public guides verify the Success Hub route, eligible-field GenAI suggestions, editable draft and separate Submit changes boundary. Current content-update and Activity Feed guides add a Feed ID, errors/Pending Review and published-effect verification after submission; unified-catalog content privileges may lock fields. No authenticated output, Feed ID, store session, submission or API was evidenced; CA/MX native-AI availability and MX Activity Feed behavior remain unknown.

tool_states.surface: Country-specific WFS onboarding, items, inbound inventory and reports
tool_states.data_boundary: Separate US/CA/MX enrollment, items, inventory and fulfillment-center identity.
tool_states.current_fact: US public docs verify inbound-quantity, restock, convert and unpublished recommendation surfaces; CA/MX public WFS programs were inspected. No real T One WFS enrollment, OAuth, payload or write authorization was evidenced.

tool_states.data_boundary: Advertiser ID and role are separate from Marketplace seller authorization.
tool_states.current_fact: Public material verifies a dated beta Marty advertising assistant, Campaign Recommendations and a current Ads API deprecation log. No advertiser ID, billing state, authorized account, assistant entitlement, report payload, campaign or spend was evidenced; post-beta availability remains unknown.

tool_states.surface: Sponsored Search reporting and campaign management APIs
tool_states.data_boundary: WCPN partner and advertiser-specific access; Reporting Only cannot write campaigns.
tool_states.current_fact: Local endpoint is a placeholder and disabled; no WCPN or advertiser authorization was evidenced. The public 2026-07-15 deprecation log and Campaign Recommendations pages are verified, but no local schema preflight, request, response or parser has been implemented or tested.

tool_states.surface: Marketplace Search Engine Marketing campaigns, recommendations, reports and billing
tool_states.data_boundary: US-only Marketplace seller OAuth and SEM eligibility; separate from Walmart Connect and any seller-owned Google Ads identity.
tool_states.current_fact: Public guides and request/response examples were inspected, but no OAuth token, SEM enrollment, campaign or billing record was evidenced.

tool_states.data_boundary: Separate item, order, inventory, shipment, settlement and ads scopes per store/site.
tool_states.current_fact: Capability names exist, but no real Walmart ERP connection or field mapping was evidenced.

tool_states.data_boundary: Analyze lawful public structure only; do not download or republish protected assets without authorization.
tool_states.current_fact: Always blocked without ownership or commercial license evidence.

native_tools.editable_boundary: Public evidence proves the Seller Center insight/recommendation surface only. Exact private output and any resulting content, price, shipping, WFS, support or other action require a matching store session, review and separate owner approval.
native_tools.api_status: The AI explanation surface has no public API verified; GET /v3/insights/sellerIncentives is publicly documented for tier, criteria and reward data.
native_tools.human_gate: Treat recommendations as suggestions; verify metrics and approve any resulting write action.

native_tools.entry: Walmart Seller app; authenticated use requires the matching US Seller Center account
native_tools.site_boundary: The current May 11 guide says the app cannot manage Marketplace business in Canada, Mexico or Chile. App Store and Google Play download restrictions differ and do not prove that a country market can be managed.
native_tools.editable_boundary: Public documentation exposes both read and write-capable mobile controls. Every price, inventory, order, cancellation, return, refund, tracking or shipped-status write still requires a store-scoped diff, owner confirmation and post-write effect verification. WFS inventory is documented as monitoring, not arbitrary WFS inventory modification.
native_tools.api_status: No public Seller App API was verified. Reuse the existing Marketplace API domains separately with matching OAuth; an app login or public mobile screen is not API authorization.
native_tools.human_gate: Do not install, log in, log out, change account security, contact Support or execute any product, price, inventory, order, refund, tracking or shipment write without owner approval.

native_tools.entry: Seller Center > Advertising > Search Engine Marketing
native_tools.editable_boundary: Recommendations may be reviewed and drafted; create, update, stop, delete or auto-apply remain write actions.
native_tools.api_status: Public API guides verified; real request schema remains blocked because no OAuth and the guide has a request-field inconsistency.
native_tools.human_gate: Review projected metrics and require approval before auto-apply, budget, bidding, launch, stop or delete.

native_tools.entry: Walmart Connect Ad Center Sponsored Search assistant; Advertising Partners Campaign Recommendations API
native_tools.site_boundary: The Jan 6, 2026 Walmart Connect article described the assistant as beta and promised broader access later in the half. No current account entitlement or CA/MX rollout was verified; do not infer availability from the article or the public portal.
native_tools.editable_boundary: Chat, reports and recommendations are read/review inputs. Any campaign, bid, budget, billing, creative, item, shipping, price or review action is a separate write with current authorization, diff, owner approval and effect verification.
native_tools.api_status: Public pages and request samples were inspected. The local Connect endpoint remains disabled and placeholder; no advertiser payload or call was made. Check the current deprecation log before every test and reject removed names or fields.
native_tools.human_gate: Do not turn Marty text, outOfBudget values, itemAlerts, Smart Performance alpha text or early-beta creative claims into automatic actions or performance promises.

native_tools.entry: Seller Center pricing tools and Marketplace Pricing Insights API
native_tools.human_gate: Owner confirmation before price, floor, strategy or promotional change.

native_tools.api_status: POST /v3/growth/assortment/recommendations and related read APIs are publicly documented; Reject recommendations is a separate write action.
native_tools.human_gate: Do not treat a recommendation as demand proof or publish without product, IP, margin and supply validation.

native_tools.entry: Walmart Developer Portal Taxonomy and Get Spec APIs, or the matching country Seller Center/spec surface
native_tools.editable_boundary: Taxonomy and schema reads may prepare a tenant-scoped draft. They do not authorize item creation, maintenance, WFS conversion or publication.
native_tools.api_status: US Taxonomy and Get Spec public request contracts were verified in a headed browser. CA public categorization and MX v4.X site-specific specs were also verified. No authorized payload exists, and US endpoint/version fields must not be copied to CA or MX.
native_tools.human_gate: Keep all user facts tenant scoped and require owner confirmation before any feed submission, item write, price, inventory or fulfillment effect.

native_tools.editable_boundary: All four surfaces are read-only recommendations. They do not create inbound shipments, approve conversion to WFS, repair unpublished items or publish inventory.
native_tools.api_status: Four US public guides were operated in a headed browser. Connector implementation remains blocked because the shipment guide conflicts on endpoint/auth examples and the restock guide conflicts on one output field name; no OAuth token or sandbox payload was available.
native_tools.human_gate: Verify item eligibility, live inventory, storage/fulfillment cost, margin, supply and owner approval before any inbound, conversion, listing repair or publication write.

native_tools.entry: Seller Center > Growth > Success Hub > Edit Listings with Gen AI; exact Smart Assistant navigation remains unknown without authorization
native_tools.site_boundary: The public workflow is US-facing and refers to Walmart.com. Exact CA and MX guide paths loaded localized shells with No Data found, which does not prove feature unavailability; CA/MX entry, localization and eligibility remain unknown.
native_tools.editable_boundary: The public guide verifies that Use this Suggestion may be kept as-is or edited and that Submit changes is a separate final write. Treat selection/editing as a draft and require explicit owner approval before Submit changes. After submission, retain a pending effect until Feed ID, Activity Feed errors, Pending Review and the published item or authorized API state are checked. Processed is not publication or display proof.
native_tools.api_status: No public Gen AI API endpoint or authorized payload was verified. Public guides/GIF/video are demonstration evidence only; the Seller Center route still requires a matching store identity. Smart Assistant inputs, outputs and route, authenticated Feed IDs and Mexico Activity Feed behavior remain unknown.
native_tools.human_gate: Resolve dynamic schema, content privileges, every product fact, claim, compliance requirement and content right; then require explicit owner approval before Submit changes or any item submission/publication. Brand privilege applications and legal-document uploads are owner-controlled external actions. Smart Assistant text, Success Hub suggestions, receipts and processed feeds are not completed effects without verification.

native_tools.site_boundary: Only US public request contracts were verified. The 2026-07-06 mapping identifies no active Global equivalent for the inspected US payment-report endpoints. CA/MX sheets contain no payment-report row; absence and earlier country-path 404s do not prove API unavailability, so CA/MX remain unknown.
native_tools.editable_boundary: The layer is read-only. It does not move money, change settlement, confirm a bank deposit, issue a refund or prove profit. Any financial change or external action remains owner-gated.
native_tools.api_status: The current US API Reference resolves the public documentation ambiguity for schema design in favor of the detailed Payment Statement object. The connector remains available_unconnected because the legal sandbox attempt returned 401 without credentials and no authorized payload exists. Preserve raw payloads, do not route through Global, and keep CA/MX unknown.
native_tools.human_gate: Require matching store authorization for reads and owner-authorized bank or payout evidence before confirming money movement; require verified product, fulfillment, return, advertising, tax and other costs before profit.

rules.rule: Authentication is isolated by country site, seller store and ownership: US OAuth, Canada signature plus tenant and locale, and Chile OAuth plus WM_MARKET may not be conflated.
An MCP destructive-tool hint or schema annotation is not owner approval and cannot authorize a write.
Idempotency records for item, inventory, price, order and shipment writes are persistent, atomic, store-scoped and restart-safe.
Do not acknowledge an upstream ERP or owner action before Walmart accepts it and a post-effect readback confirms the intended state.
Tokens, client secrets, buyer PII, order payloads and presigned report URLs are sensitive and never appear in prompts, ordinary logs or shared evidence.
Rate limits, quotas and retry intervals remain endpoint, account, site and time scoped; community wrappers cannot establish global values.

regression_cases.scenario: Use a Walmart US OAuth example for a Canada store without tenant, locale and the current signature contract.
Execute an inventory delete because an MCP tool marks the operation destructive.
Log a presigned Walmart report URL and raw buyer order payload for debugging.
Hardcode one community wrapper quota and retry policy for every Walmart market and account.
